# U147: The first import (U92’s second half): at /?store=browser, set-up with a spreadsheet whose goals name an owner nobody typed ends on the import’s preview, not a dead end: Must fix offers “Add {name}” and “Give it to someone here”, the stage question is already answered “Count them from this week” and can be changed, Create waits for the answers, and nothing is saved before it; afterwards the person added owns their goal and no stage is due before this week

- **Belongs to:** the core ([the journeys](../journeys.md)); it runs with every module on, and the core journeys run again with each module left out
- **Requirements:** `SETUP-UPLOAD`, `IMPORT-PREVIEW`, `ONBOARDING`
- **Budget:** at most 18 steps on each width
- **Ease test:** all ten points ([the ease test](../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Grace, at `/workspace/new` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U147

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Grace (`grace`).
- Go to `/workspace/new` in the real app, its data kept in this browser.
- **Check:** The step counter shows.
- **Check:** (`progress`) a progress indicator (a ring, steps, dots, a checklist or a bar) is visible.
- **Step.** Type “Depot Network” into the “Workspace name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Ana Silva” into the “Your name” field.
- **Step.** Type “Depots” into the “Your team” field.
- **Step.** Type “ana.silva@example.com” into the “Your email” field.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to people” button.
- **Step.** Type “Ben Carter” into the “Person 1: name” field.
- **Step.** Type “ben.carter@example.com” into the “Person 1: email” field.
- **Check:** (`entry`) the “Upload a spreadsheet” button is in view without scrolling (above the phone’s tab bar).
- _Note:_ A goals sheet only: its second goal's owner is on no one's list, and its stages began in week 2.
- Choose “depots.csv” to load; the file is `{ name: 'depots.csv', mimeType: 'text/csv', buffer: Buffer.from(csv) }`, where `const csv = ['Goal,Team,Owner email,Owner,Type,Unit,Start,Target,Stages', 'Parcels on time,Depots,ben.carter@example.com,Ben Carter,metric,%,91,97,', 'Night shift rota,Depots,nia.okoro@example.com,Nia Okoro,milestone,,,,Draft@2; Agreed@6; Live@50', // A team one letter from Depots: asked, not made a second team (#336 review). 'Sort times,Depot,ben.carter@example.com,Ben Carter,metric,min,40,30,'].join('\n')`.
- **Check:** “Read depots.csv” is shown (else: the upload is not said).
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to goals” button.
- **Step.** Press the “Import a spreadsheet” choice.
- **Step.** Press the “Continue to check” button.
- **Check:** “From depots.csv” is shown (else: Check does not show the spreadsheet’s preview).
- **Check:** “3 goals and 2 people would be added, once the 2 goals below are settled” is shown (else: the preview’s count leaves the goals to fix out).
- **Check:** Checkpoint “preview”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- _Note:_ The preview's Must fix: Nia isn't here; two answers, "Add Nia Okoro" first.
- **Check:** (`errors`) met when `answers.join(' | ') === 'Add Nia Okoro | Give it to someone here'`, where `const fix = p.locator('.import-group.level-fix').filter({ hasText: 'nia.okoro@example.com' })`; `const answers = await fix.locator('.import-answer').allInnerTexts()`. Else it says: the owner nobody typed is answered with: {answers.join(' | ') || 'nothing'}.
- _Note:_ Create waits for the answer, and says why; nothing is saved.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Depot Network” button.
- **Check:** (`one-action`) an alert showing “depots.csv” is visible (else: Create with a question open does not say why it waits).
- **Check:** It fails if a workspace was saved before Create Depot Network.
- **Step.** Press the “Add Nia Okoro” choice in the import group level fix (`.import-group.level-fix`) showing “nia.okoro@example.com”.
- **Check:** “3 goals and 3 people would be added” is shown (else: adding Nia does not count her).
- _Note:_ After an answer the focus goes on, never to the page (#336 review): here to the team's question.
- **Step.** Press the “Use Depots” choice in the import group (`.import-group`) showing “Depot” showing “Did you mean”.
- **Check:** (`a11y`) met when `onAfterAdd && onAfterTeam`, where `const onAfterAdd = await p.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body)`; `const onAfterTeam = await p.evaluate(() => !!document.activeElement && document.activeElement !== document.body)`. Else it says: after an answer the focus fell to the page (after Add: {onAfterAdd}, after the team: {onAfterTeam}).
- _Note:_ Her goal's stages, asked once its owner is settled: answered for you, "Count them from this week", with Change.
- **Check:** (`attention`) met when `await stages.waitFor({ timeout: 5000 }).then(() => true, () => false)`, where `const stages = p.locator('.import-answered').filter({ hasText: 'would start late: Count them from this week' })`. Else it says: the stage question is not answered “Count them from this week”.
- **Check:** Checkpoint “answered”: the screen is scored for `one-action` and `a11y`.
- **Step.** Press the “Create Depot Network” button.
- **Check:** The address becomes “/ready”.
- Set up in the page’s own script, not a step a person takes: it runs `() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace')`.
- **Check:** (`finish`) met when `!!rota && !!nia && rota.ownerId === nia.id && nia.teamId === depots?.id && sort?.teamId === depots?.id && !s.teams.some((t) => t.name === 'Depot')`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace'))`; `const s = await h.snapshot(wsId)`; `const rota = s && s.goals.find((g) => g.title === 'Night shift rota')`; `const nia = s && s.people.find((x) => x.email === 'nia.okoro@example.com')`; `const depots = s && s.teams.find((t) => t.name === 'Depots')`; `const sort = s && s.goals.find((g) => g.title === 'Sort times')`. Else it says: Nia does not own the rota in Depots, or Sort times is not in Depots (or a second team “Depot” was made).
- **Check:** (`logged`) met when `!!rota && rota.stages.every((x) => x.dueWeek > NOW)`, where `const wsId = await p.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('goals-live-workspace'))`; `const s = await h.snapshot(wsId)`; `const rota = s && s.goals.find((g) => g.title === 'Night shift rota')`; `NOW` is 45. Else it says: a stage starts already due: {worked out in the journey as `JSON.stringify(rota?.stages.map((x) => x.dueWeek))`}.
- Close this browser.
